className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

code.zh-CN: 代码纯文本，未传时按空字符串处理。`code` 变化后先显示新文本，高亮完成后再替换。
code.en-US: Plain text of the code, treated as an empty string when omitted. After `code` changes the new text shows right away and is replaced once highlighting finishes.

language.zh-CN: 语言类型，需已注册或经 `languages` 传入。
language.en-US: Language, which must be registered or passed through `languages`.

languages.zh-CN: 该代码块额外使用的 Shiki 语法，加载后其他代码块也可使用。替换为新的数组引用会重新高亮。
languages.en-US: Extra Shiki grammars for this block; once loaded, other blocks can use them too. Assigning a new array reference highlights the block again.

themes.zh-CN: 替换该代码块亮色、暗色模式下的 Shiki 主题。未设置时使用 `CodeHighlight.register` 注册的主题，默认为 `github-light` 与 `github-dark`。
themes.en-US: Replaces the Shiki themes of this block for light and dark mode. Without it, the themes registered by `CodeHighlight.register` apply, which default to `github-light` and `github-dark`.
